subject.title: macOS update can leave manual-update loop and stale node host causing Gateway restart storm

question: For macOS package updates, should repeated same-version manual updater jobs perform cleanup-only behavior or continue the current package/plugin/service refresh semantics?
rationale: The source fix is not just a matcher change: the desired behavior affects no-op update semantics, updater dedupe, service stop/restart timing, and the false-positive boundary for launchd cleanup.

options.title: Split cleanup from refresh policy
options.body: First land a metadata-safe cleanup/dedupe path for stale updater jobs, then separately decide whether same-version updates should refresh package/plugins/services.

options.title: Make same-version updates cleanup-only
options.body: Skip managed-service stop/restart and plugin sync when the package is already current, accepting a behavior change for users who expect refresh side effects.

options.title: Keep refresh semantics and harden recovery
options.body: Preserve current refresh behavior but require dedupe, launchd bootstrap verification, and node-host recovery proof so no-op loops cannot keep killing the Gateway.

recommendation.title: Split cleanup from refresh policy
recommendation.body: First land a metadata-safe cleanup/dedupe path for stale updater jobs, then separately decide whether same-version updates should refresh package/plugins/services.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has adjacent update-flow merge history and supplied the explicit safety criterion for launchd updater classification on the predecessor PR.
